data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian word ‘aiello’, meaning 'little elk' or 'moon god'. The name Aiello carries the meaning “Moon god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aiello usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
